visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short hair and a gold necklace is holding a small, black carbon fiber component in his hands, showing a countersunk hole. He is wearing a black T-shirt and is in a room with a busy workbench filled with electronic parts and tools in the background. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Close-up shots show the man's hands operating a silver mechanical device on a blue silicone mat. Yellow cartoon duck icons are superimposed on the screen. He appears to be struggling or putting in effort, as indicated by his facial expressions in intermittent cuts where he looks at the camera with a squint. (3) The man holds up a black cylindrical tool, the WORX WX-242 electric screwdriver. He is talking directly to the camera with a determined expression. The background remains the workshop with various hobbyist items visible on shelves. (4) A technical graphic appears on screen showing a golden drill bit with dimensions (4.0mm diameter, 20mm blade length, 55mm total length, 90 degrees). The man then demonstrates how to attach a chuck and the drill bit to the WORX screwdriver. He is focused on the task, looking down at his hands. (5) The man uses the electric tool to countersink a hole in the carbon fiber piece. He presses the tool down onto the part which is placed on a white tissue. The video cuts to show the final result: a smooth, perfectly flush screw head in the carbon fiber. He looks satisfied at the end.
